tool_input.description: Append sample data for the three screens

tool_input.command:
python - <<'EOF'
p='src/App.tsx'; s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
s=s.replace("import { DesignSystemPage } from './screens/DesignSystemPage';","import { DesignSystemPage } from './screens/DesignSystemPage';\nimport { GoalPage } from './screens/GoalPage';\nimport { HabitsPage } from './screens/HabitsPage';\nimport { InsightsPage } from './screens/InsightsPage';")
s=s.replace("""          <Route path="/goals/new" element={<NewGoalPage />} />""","""          <Route path="/goals/new" element={<NewGoalPage />} />
          <Route path="/goals/run-a-10k" element={<GoalPage />} />
          <Route path="/habits" element={<HabitsPage />} />
          <Route path="/insights" element={<InsightsPage />} />""")
s=s.replace(".filter((area) => area.path !== '/')",".filter((area) => !BUILT.includes(area.path))")
s=s.replace("export default function App","/** Area paths with their own screen; the rest show the area placeholder. */\nconst BUILT = ['/', '/habits', '/insights'];\n\nexport default function App")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
p='pigment.app.json'; s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
s=s.replace("""    { "path": "/goals/new", "name": "New goal", "capture": true }""","""    { "path": "/goals/new", "name": "New goal", "capture": true },
    { "path": "/goals/run-a-10k", "name": "Goal", "capture": true },
    { "path": "/insights", "name": "Insights", "capture": true },
    { "path": "/habits", "name": "Habits", "capture": true }""")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
EOF
cat pigment.app.json
tool_input.description: Wire routes and add them to pigment.app.json
